title: kailarsenia lineata
intro: Kailarsenia lineata, commonly known as the Himalayan Kailarsenia, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Pedaliaceae. The health benefits of Kailarsenia lineata include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help in alleviating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Kailarsenia lineata include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
